description:
Derive the priority tokens in the validation schema test from the `Priority` vocabulary instead of a handwritten list.

## Background

`Priority` is a closed vocabulary declared once through the vocabulary macro, and `Priority::ALL` enumerates its variants. The local-reference schema test in `crates/jit/src/validation/engine.rs` (around line 893) builds its `State` enum from `State::ALL` but writes the `Priority` enum as the literal list `["low", "normal", "high", "critical"]`, so the test restates the vocabulary and drifts if a priority is added or renamed.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The schema built by the local-reference test takes its `Priority` tokens from `Priority::ALL` and each variant's token method, as it already does for `State`.
- [hard] REQ-02: No handwritten list of `Priority` wire tokens remains under `crates/jit/src/validation/`.
title: The validation schema test derives priority tokens from the vocabulary
